description: Reissue 0.3.1 runtime isolation with publishable core/cli pair (.cstl/)
changelog:
**@blxzer/cursor-trellis 0.3.2**

Reissues 0.3.1 content with a publishable `@blxzer/cursor-trellis-core` pair. Runtime root `.trellis/` → **`.cstl/`** for coexistence with upstream Trellis.

```bash
npm install -g @blxzer/cursor-trellis@0.3.2
cstl update --migrate
```
notes: 0.3.1 was withdrawn from npm; use 0.3.2+ for the .cstl/ migration.
